Two smoke-surfaced bugs found + fixed (both genuine robustness fixes, not smoke-only workarounds):
1. **`orthogonal_procrustes` full-dim SVD hang.** `scipy.linalg.orthogonal_procrustes(A, B)` SVDs `B.T @ A` = a `(3584, 3584)` matrix per layer × 28 — pegged all 24 cores for minutes (real hang observed). Fixed: Procrustes now runs in the joint-PCA low-dim subspace the K family-centroids span (≤2K−1 dims), so the SVD is `(d, d)` with d≈10. The residual `||Cb·R − Cc||/||Cc||` is EXACT (centroids span ≤K−1 dims after centering; zero-variance discarded). CKA was already cheap (Gram form is `(K,K)`). Tagged `epm:new-bug-class procrustes_full_dim_svd_hang`.
2. **t-SNE `perplexity ≥ n_samples`.** sklearn requires `perplexity < n_samples`; the synthetic 30-sample joint bank crashed at perplexity 30. Fixed: clamp `eff_perp = min(perp, n_samples-1)`. On the real 325-point joint bank the full {5,15,30} grid is unaffected.
